rows.en: Touya: "Whoa... Are we through...?! What about everyone...?"
Touya: "We can't get back... It's just us from here on, then..."
Aurelie: "What's wrong? You're not acting like yourself."
Touya: "Aren't you... worried?"
Aurelie: "Hmm... I'd be lying
if I said I wasn't worried. But... more than that,
I feel like we'll manage somehow."
Touya: "...Have you got any reason for that?"
Aurelie: "None at all."
Touya: "Oh, come on..."
Aurelie: "But if I had to name one, it'd be because Touya and Yamato-chan
are here with me, I suppose."
Yamato: "That's right! The three of us have always managed meow,
so we'll be fine this time too!"
Touya: "Yeah... You're right. Okay, let's go."
Aurelie: "Is this... the 'Core'...?"
Yamato: "It's absurdly enormous..."
Voice: (Welcome to my castle.)
Touya: "?! What? Right into my head..."
Aurelie: "What's wrong?"
Touya: "You can't hear it?"
Aurelie: "...Hear what?"
Touya: "I see...
Someone's speaking directly into my head."
Aurelie: "Huh? Someone...?"
Voice: (At last, someone has reached this place...)
Touya: (...Who the hell are you?)
Voice: (Ah, yes... How does this sound?
Has it become a familiar voice?)
Touya: (This is... Debish?!
You bastard, you're alive?!)
Voice: (Hahahahaha!)
Touya: (What the hell is so funny?!)
Voice: (...Oh, forgive me.
Your train of thought was so very simplistic.
I was indeed once inside him, but I am not him.
Let's see... You wouldn't be wrong to think of me as
a being like that person from Lin Karma who traveled with you.
That should serve as an explanation.)
Touya: (A consciousness that can exist without its body...)
Voice: (Though I am something purer and more essential.
In any case, you have done admirably.
Who could have imagined that failure back then would bear such fruit?)
Touya: (Back then... Don't tell me you mean 109 years ago...)
Voice: (Exactly. I had thought it would succeed...
But thanks to that, someone as gifted as you has appeared.
In the end, perhaps it was not a mistake.
They performed well too.
Debish, Lyle, Bernst... And Sharl.
They all served me most devotedly...)
Touya: (What exactly do you want?)
Voice: (...You humans of the solar system were remarkably amusing
creatures.
You will sacrifice your own kind without hesitation for your own desires,
and yet you also try to save them...
It is most intriguing.
Watching your actions never bores me.
What was the term...? Ah, yes.
In your world, you would call it 'entertainment,' wouldn't you?)
Touya: (Entertainment... you say...?)
Voice: (Yes, entertainment.
Your struggles, your suffering... And the way you face me despite it all.
Nothing is more entertaining than a true battle
with lives on the line... Hehehehe.)
Touya: (Why would you do such a thing?!)
Voice: (Why? You ask such amusing questions.
Because I am bored. What else?
We are free of time's shackles and can create even the future,
and to beings such as ourselves,
everyday life is nothing but tedium.
That is why chosen beings like me
indulge in games like this to while away the hours.
Yes, with the extinction of our own existence at stake.)
Touya: (You're bored...? You bastard...
Just for something like that...!!)
Voice: (...Have you ever placed yourself
in the aimless passage of time?
Nothing changes. The same time simply passes, over and over...
At first, I too took it for granted.
I did not even question it. But that was wrong.
On distant stars, far beyond our galaxy,
I observed the lives of humans who live but a fleeting moment,
and they brought a time of refreshment to my empty heart.
Risking their lives, fighting and winning, they showed me life's brilliance.
This excitement I felt
was understood by only a handful of others.
But that is of no consequence.
For I am spending my time in fulfillment now.)
Touya: (I'll never forgive you... Playing with people's lives
just to pass the time... I'll never forgive you!!)
Voice: (Good, yes. Come at me just like that.
The future of humanity now rests in your hands.
In that Rayblade you are piloting.)
Touya: (What do you mean?)
Voice: (Whenever humanity has faced a crisis throughout recorded history,
there has always been something to stop it, has there not?
At times a person, at times a sword,
at times an ideology...
Something fitting to each era saved humanity.
Have you never found it strange
that things should work out so conveniently?)
Touya: (D-Don't tell me...)
Voice: (Yes, it was I. Those fools from Lin Karma
apparently thought they had sealed Vorlia away,
but I could have left that place any time I wanted.
I simply had no need to leave.
Above all, it kept them from interfering.
It was convenient for playing with you humans, who only make superficial repairs
and never learn the fundamental lessons.
...And this time, that Rayblade is what will save humanity.
It is the 'key.'
The only being capable of stopping this Vorlia.
That is why you made it all the way here...)
Touya: (...But if we're still alive,
doesn't that mean you lost before?)
Voice: (No, they failed. They were not even able
to reach me... And so, with their aims unfulfilled,
they all sank into the depths of history...)
Touya: (...Then I'll finish it this time.)
Voice: (Hehehe... Yes. A wager must be conducted
on equal terms. If I placed myself somewhere safe,
I could not experience true enjoyment.
A sense of tension, you might call it?
It amplifies the enjoyment many times over.
That is why I am offering you this chance.)
Touya: (...)
Voice: (Destroy this 'Core' with Rayblade,
and neither Vorlia nor I can maintain our existence. We will disappear.
And this world will be saved...
Hehehehe... Well then, may I get started?)
Touya: "..."
Aurelie: "...Who?"
Touya: "..."
Aurelie: "Touya? Hey, what's wrong?"
Touya: "...Huh? I was just talking..."
Aurelie: "Talking...? In those few seconds?"
Touya: "...A few seconds...? I see..."
Voice: (Are you surprised? This is another thing I can do.)
Touya: (...You're one hell of a monster...)
Voice: (Hehehehe... Well, shall we begin...?)
Yamato: "Wh-What is that?!"
Aurelie: "A black Rayblade...
But there's something different about it..."
Touya: "...Let's go."
Aurelie: "Huh?"
Touya: "Once we beat that thing, it'll all be over."
Yamato: "What's going on? Explain properly..."
Aurelie: "...All right."
Yamato: "Aurelie?!"
Aurelie: "If Touya says so, I believe him.
I've made up my mind. So... let's leave it to him."
Yamato: "Aurelie..."
Voice: (...Hmm? Are you damaged...?
It won't be entertaining unless you face me
in perfect condition... Very well.)
Aurelie: "The damage... It's healing..."
Touya: "..."
Voice: (Now, entertain me!)
Touya: (Let's put an end to this.)
Voice: (Heh... Hehehehe... Very well.
Then bring it all to an end with your own hands...)
Touya: (You don't need to tell me. I will.)
Voice: (Excellent, this is quite entertaining...
But it seems you can go no further...
Still, my capable pawns have served me well this time.
It has been most enjoyable... But
it is time for us to part...)
Voice: (...So you have disappointed me...
You were doing so well until now...
Even so, my capable pawns have served me well this time.
It has been most enjoyable... So
I shall erase you instantly and painlessly...)
Touya: "Ghh........"
Aurelie: "Don't give up!
Don't abandon hope, right to the end!"
Touya: "...Y-Yeah... You're right.
Sorry..."
Voice: (It is futile...)
Voice: (What?! I-Impossible... You...)
Kasumi: "Touya-chan! Aurelie! Yamato-chan!
Is everyone okay?!"
Touya: "Kasumi!"
Clovis: "Hey, looks like you're struggling."
Arthur: "It's not fair for you two
to take all the glory, you know."
Aurelie: "Everyone..."
Fain: "You can rest easy now that we're here!"
Xiujian: "...Heh."
Melissa: "It really is best when we're all together."
Ai: "This is how a finale should be!"
Gen: "I'm going to finish this in style too!"
Kururu: "Heeey, I'm here too!"
Voice: (Why...? To break through that barrier...)
Rayfon: (You should not underestimate the humans of this world.
Humanity, who have established themselves as individuals.
Their individual strength may be small, but when they connect,
they bring forth power beyond what one would expect...
That is the nature of humanity here.
Being imperfect, they try to compensate
by cooperating with others. From this emerges a power
that is unpredictable and cannot be reduced to numbers.
Trust, friendship, love... It takes all sorts of forms.
Do you know what it is called?)
Voice: (...)
Rayfon: (Its name... is 'bonds.'
You believe in yourselves alone, trusting no one,
relied on by no one, loving no one.
I doubt your kind could understand.)
Voice: (Hehehehe... Hahahahaha!
Amusing! More amusing by the moment!
Very well. I grant you all the right
to join this wager!)
Voice: (...?! Why?! Why won't they come forth?!)
Rishuna: (It is no use. We have sealed off this space.
You can no longer summon anything.)
Voice: (Ghh...)
Valga: (It is time to bring this to a close.)
Voice: (It appears... I underestimated you a little...
But I can do this as well...)
Clovis: "What?! What's going on...?"
Arthur: "An illusion...? No, that isn't it..."
Xiujian: "...So the last enemy is oneself..."
Voice: (Now, let the merry banquet begin!!)
Touya: "...We're going straight in."
Aurelie: "Yes. Our target is the black Rayblade..."
Touya: "Yeah. I might get a little reckless."
Aurelie: "I won't hesitate anymore.
Because I trust you, Touya..."
Clovis: "Th-This is..."
Fain: "Oh!"
Celica: "I can't believe it..."
Touya: "...Let's go!!"
Aurelie: "Everyone!"
Clovis: "Are you two all right?!"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Xiujian: "...It seems the outcome is decided."
Yamato: "...I'm here too, you know..."
Voice: (...Splendid... That was most entertaining...)
Touya: (It's over.)
Voice: (Hehehehe... Indeed...
But this does not mean it is all over...)
Touya: (...What do you mean...?)
Voice: (I will indeed disappear.
But unless you annihilate the Core,
you cannot stop Vorlia...)
Touya: (What?!)
Voice: (...It was quite entertaining...
Experiencing extinction is not so bad... either...)
Touya: (W-Wait! How can I annihilate the Core?!)
Voice: (...I told you Rayblade was the key...
You must figure out what to do for yourself...)
Touya: (The key... For myself...)
Voice: (...Hehehehe... It is a shame that I cannot
watch this through to the end, but I wish you success... Farewell...)
Touya: "..."
Aurelie: "...Touya?"
Touya: "O-Oh... Sorry."
Aurelie: "...What's wrong?
We won, didn't we?"
Touya: "...No. It's not over yet."
Aurelie: "Huh?"
Aurelie: "Huh? Wh-What...?"
Yamato: "Is Vorlia moving?
What in the world is...?"
Touya: "...Tch. It won't even let me think..."
Aurelie: "..."
Touya: "...Listen."
Yamato: "Huh? Why have you switched to transmission mode?
Hey. Hey, Tou..."
Aurelie: "...Yamato-chan."
Yamato: "What... Huh?"
Aurelie: "...Let's leave it to Touya.
Let's trust him and follow his lead."
Yamato: "Aurelie... Y-Yeah... You're right."
Touya: "...I'm going to destroy Vorlia's Core now.
But only this Rayblade can do it.
So I want you to head back before us."
Fain: "Hey! What the hell do you mean?!"
Touya: "...I know it's selfish of me
to ask this after we've come this far.
But it's not because I don't believe in you.
It's because I believe in you, because I trust you, that I want you to go back.
And reassure me that I have somewhere to return to,
somewhere I have to return to..."
Clovis: "Hey, you can't do this after we've come so far.
I'm with you to the end."
Xiujian: "Heh... Do you think we'd just obey
if you told us to go back? I haven't sunk so low that I'd go off alone
and leave everything to a comrade."
Arthur: "How cold... I'll accompany you to the end."
Fain: "What are you saying?! I'll stay with you to the end too!"
Rayfon: "We should accept reality calmly.
There is nothing we can do as we are now.
It is frustrating... But it is the truth.
So we should not make things any harder for him.
If we really believe in him, if we really are his comrades,
we should leave this to him."
Rayfon: "...But you must keep
your promise to return."
Touya: "...Yeah. I'll do my best."
Clovis: "Touya... No, forget it.
It'll only be a brief parting."
Touya: "...I'm counting on you to handle things back there."
Clovis: "Yeah. Don't die!"
Xiujian: "........I won't bid you farewell."
Touya: "Yeah... I'm counting on you to handle things back there."
Xiujian: "...Understood."
Arthur: "...I won't say goodbye."
Touya: "Yeah. I won't either."
Arthur: "...Be careful..."
Touya: "I'm counting on you to handle things back there."
Fain: "...A-All right! But don't you dare die!
That's a promise!"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan... I'll be waiting.
So I won't say goodbye..."
Touya: "Yeah. Just wait a little while."
Kasumi: "Okay. I understand........Come back safely."
Touya: "...I'll be back."
Touya: "...Well then, let's go."
Yamato: "Go...?"
Aurelie: "...You're going to use Rayblade itself."
Touya: "Oh, you figured it out. I should've known."
Aurelie: "Of course.
But... Rayblade will break.
And us too..."
Touya: "Yeah..."
Aurelie: "..."
Touya: "For things to end up like this..."
Aurelie: "Don't say any more.
I told you, didn't I? I won't hesitate anymore.
I trust you, Touya."
Touya: "Aurelie..."
Aurelie: "But if this will save Agarthia..."
Touya: "...I'm sorry, putting you through this..."
Aurelie: "It's okay. Thank you for everything.
I had a lot of fun..."
Aurelie: "..."
Touya: "...Shall we go...?"
Aurelie: "Yes."
Touya: "Raaaaaaaagh!!"
Aurelie: "Gooooo!"
